subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The late secretary of our society was known for his __ruthless__ treatment of all the security personnel of the society.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ruthless"** means showing no compassion or pity for others; being cruel and unkind. (निर्दयी)

 
 
• **Example: **The ruthless dictator showed no mercy to his enemies.
 
 
 
• **"Compassionate"** refers to showing empathy, kindness, and concern for others; being understanding and considerate. (दयालु)
 
 
• **Example: **The compassionate nurse comforted the patient during their difficult time.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate antonym for **'ruthless'** is **'compassionate'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Startled **(चौंका हुआ): Feeling sudden shock or surprise.

 
 
• **Example:** She was startled by the unexpected noise coming from the kitchen.
 
 
 
• **Fragile **(नाजुक): Easily broken or damaged; delicate.
 
 
• **Example:** Handle the fragile glassware with care to avoid breaking it.
 
 
 
• **Brutal **(क्रूर): Extremely cruel and harsh; showing no mercy.
 
 
• **Example:** The brutal attack left everyone in the town horrified.
